item.title: Arson at election offices in Lakshmipur
item.description: Barely hours after the attack on Dhaka-8 election hopeful Sharif Osman Hadi on December 12, miscreants launched arson attacks on election offices in Lakshmipur and Pirojpur, triggering fresh alarm over the security of election-related institutions.In Lakshmipur, the District Election Office was set on fire in the early hours of Saturday. item.title: UN condemns over death of 6 Bangladeshi peacekeepers in Sudan
item.description: UN chief Antonio Guterres condemned Saturday's "horrific" drone attack on Bangladeshi peacekeepers in Sudan, a strike that killed six people and wounded six others.In a statement he said, "I strongly condemn the horrific drone attacks that targeted the United Nations peacekeeping logistics base in Kadugli, Sudan.""Attacks targeting United Nations peacekeepers may constitute war crimes under international law," he added. item.title: Suspect Masud's bank accounts freezed over Hadi shooting
item.description: The Central Intelligence Cell (CIC) of the National Board of Revenue has frozen all bank accounts of Faisal Karim Masud alias Daud Khan and his IT firm in connection with the murder attempt of Inqilab Mancha spokesperson Sharif Osman bin Hadi.A senior CIC official confirmed this on Sunday morning, saying the accounts were frozen as part of the ongoing investigation into the attack.Masud is a member of the Bangladesh Association of Software and Information Services and the owner of Apple Soft IT
